title: FREE REQUEST Looking for writers ( rpg maker xp )

posts.author: NaMosca
posts.body:
Hello everyone. I'm the founder and creator of the project Wings at War — or WaW, if you prefer.
Project link:
XP - Wings at War rpg
Wings at War  tags: Nature, Elementals, Angels and demons, Farm, Craft, Monster Report, Achievements, Manage items, inspired by Ragnarok Online and Skyrim         Mechanics Features (until now. It may change)  - Alchemy System by Quentin - Blacksmith System by /_Lucas (me) - Dialogue Avatar...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
A teammate and I have already created the game's lore, which you can check out in the Wings at War project thread.
We're currently recruiting writers to help build the main story and main quest. We use RPG Maker XP as engine.
For now, the project is intended to be free and released in episodes, up to 10 total.
In the future, we may re-release the project in a commercial format.
>>Join our TEAM (discord click here) <<
Current Team:
Writers:
/_Lucas or Ark (NaMosca here)
Lilbunnyhop
(More roles coming soon)
PROJECT RULES – "Wings at War"
1.This is an amateur, non-profit project.
2.If the project becomes commercial in the future, all collaborators will be contacted for formal consent. No content will be used commercially without proper written authorization.
3.All collaboration is 100% voluntary.
4.There are no promises of payment or compensation.
5.All content created must be original or properly licensed for free use.
6. All submitted content may be used exclusively within the Wings at War franchise, including the main game and all future titles set in the same universe (e.g., games using the “WaW” prefix), with proper credit given.
7.Respect and common sense are essential to keep a healthy and friendly environment.
If you agree with these rules, feel free to join and participate!
nd participate!
